records.claimDecision: Promote main by fast-forward to the exact candidate SHA rather than creating a merge commit, so main/tag bytes remain identical to the SHA proven by hosted CI.

R46 promotion required fresh-install Windows, Linux/static, console virtual, Android API36 emulator, iOS Xcode26 simulator and aggregate virtual acceptance on the exact SHA; all passed on candidate, main and tag contexts.
GitHub server-side digests and independent re-download SHA-256 values exactly match the accepted local Windows R46 and unchanged Linux R14 bytes.
Installed R45 correctly detects public R46 as newer and selects the exact R46 asset/digest without changing the active CFON session, default-route state or DNS state.
Installed Linux 4.2.0-linux.14-r41 sees v4.3.2 Linux R14 as equal revision and correctly reports updateAvailable=false; route, DNS and session hashes remain unchanged.
records.evidenceSource: Owner laptop read-only installed update_check on 2026-10-04
